article.story: AMHERST, Mass. -- — Jordan Clayton had 12 points in UMass’ 76-44 victory over Maine on Saturday. Clayton also added five rebounds for the Minutemen (3-2). Junjie Wang scored 11 points and added nine rebounds. Dwayne Wimbley Jr. shot 3 for 11, including 1 for 3 from beyond the arc to finish with nine points. Yanis Bamba led the way for the Black Bears (2-5) with 10 points. Maine also got 10 points from Hudson Franz. DeAndre Williams also had six points and five steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
